summary: Cut ten more upward module references (store to api and reconcile, backup, provenance, message bodies, checkout, GitHub spender, setup output, handoff tags, observer conditions); the module allowlist shrinks from 20 to 10 pairs

replay.detail: Definitions move between modules and keep their paths through re-exports. No claim, projection or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes; the backup archive format moves into store/backup_format.rs unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, harness, route, CLI output or exit code changes.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
